        have h₁₄ : Real.sin (m - n) = 0 := h₁₂
        have h₁₅ : ∃ (k : ℤ), m - n = k * π := by
          rw [Real.sin_eq_zero_iff] at h₁₄
          obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₁₄
          refine' ⟨k, _⟩
          linarith
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₁₅
        refine' ⟨k, _⟩
        linarith
      exact h₁₃
